bibl.title: Ὠιὸν δίδυμον (P. Cair. Zen. IV 59602, IIIa, Philadelphia): some remarks
bibl.seg: Dimitris Roumpekas, Ὠιὸν δίδυμον (P. Cair. Zen. IV 59602, IIIa, Philadelphia): some remarks.
bibl.note: Studies the phrase ὠιὸν δίδυμον found in the mutilated order P. Cair. Zen. IV 59602, 2 from the Zenon archive. Thorough research both on the interpretations of the adjective δίδυμος in connection with the ὠιόν in various modern lexica of ancient Greek language and on excerpts from certain zoological treatises of Aristotle and Pliny's Naturalis Historia interprets the phrase ὠιὸν δίδυμον as 'double-yolked egg'.
